purpose: Canonical dev/test dataset for LiquidHR Salary Structures architecture, calculations, RLS, revisions, CAO linking and legacy salary-flow regression.

data_policy.public_salary_data: CAO Rijk revision effective 2026-07-01 is transcribed from the official CAO Rijk public salary table.
data_policy.synthetic_salary_data: All salary bands, compact step scales and future revisions are synthetic but realistic and exist to exercise product rules and edge cases.
data_policy.production_use: TEST ONLY. Never import this fixture into production.

source_references.title: CAO Rijk — De salarisschalen en maandbedragen per 1 juli 2026

revisions.generation_rule: Synthetic test revision: +3.00% to every 2026-07-01 amount, rounded to EUR 0.01.
Synthetic test revision: +2.50% to all anchors; open top remains open.

legacy_employment_salary_regression_case.expected_behavior: Existing minimum-wage service remains authoritative; fixture intentionally contains no copied statutory amount.
No salary-structure relation and no salary amount required.

migration_conflict_cases.reason: Same legacy scale code exists in two administrations but step amounts differ.
